_description: Weight in grams for items whose SKU is NOT a product in Shopify, so the label popup does not show 0 kg. One line per SKU, SKU on the left (not case sensitive), grams on the right. Items linked to a Shopify product use the product's own weight. Used when an order is imported, so it does not change orders already in Shopify. Keep the commas and quotes exactly as below.
